source_basis: Demonstrated live failure case (UniCredit Bank Germany EUR29B MTN offer, flagged 2026-07-31); documented prime-bank-instrument / advance-fee fraud patterns (FBI IC3, FinCEN advisories — full dataset sourcing is a v1.1 open item, see spec section 7)
note: Scores are additive per submission. This is a starting weighting, not a final calibration — thresholds must be validated against real transaction history before enforcement is tuned (see spec section 7, scoring thresholds open item).

patterns.description: LTV or fee terms explicitly stated as non-negotiable, especially paired with a high LTV (>=85%)
Claims of monetizing/leasing a sovereign, bank, or corporate bond via a private intermediary outside normal capital markets issuance
DOA (Declaration of Authorization), BCL (Bank Comfort/Confirmation Letter), and CIS bundled together with urgency language ahead of a call/meeting to finalize
patterns.regex: (DOA|declaration of authorization).{0,80}(BCL|bank comfort|bank confirmation).{0,80}(CIS|client information sheet)

patterns.description: Unverified video-call finalization step ('G-Meet', 'Zoom call to finalize') substituting for verified institutional contact
Upfront commission, processing fee, or due-diligence fee required before verified counterparty contact
Bond or MTN described as created/issued on demand to match a specific private transaction's face value — real sovereign/bank bonds are not issued this way
Credit default swap terminology appearing inside a bond purchase confirmation or MTN offer — does not belong in this document type
Corporate action notice referencing an action type with no real-world equivalent

note_on_thresholds: score >= block_threshold => hard block, no auto-clear. score >= review_threshold and < block_threshold => mandatory human review. score < review_threshold does NOT mean 'verified' — independent-channel counterparty verification is still required per spec section 3.3 before instrument_integrity_status can be set to 'verified'.
